title_source_description: In the following Ignition Working Conditions: Ignition On Ignition Pre Start Ignition Start Ignition Cranking Ignition On Engine On the user can mange the vehicle setup menu through TLM_Display.GUI.

In case of transition FROM "Ignition On" or "Ignition Pre Start" or "Ignition Start" or "Ignition Cranking" or "Ignition On Engine On" TO "Ignition Pre Off" or "Ignition Off" Ignition Working Conditions: TLM shall store the last setup settings.
IF "Cornering_Lights" PROXI parameter is equal to "absent" THEN TLM shall not display the Cornering Light menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "Cornering_Lights" PROXI parameter is equal to "present" THEN TLM shall display the Cornering Light menu item and the user can perform setting.
IF the user sets "Cornering_Enable.Req" internal signals to "Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.CorneringEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "True" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "Cornering_Enable.Req" internal signals as "Not_Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.CorneringEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "False" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.CorneringLightsEnable" message THEN TLM updates the Cornering information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Greeting_Lights_Menù" PROXI parameter is equal to "Absent" THEN TLM shall not display the Greeting Light menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "Greeting_Lights_Menù" PROXI parameter is equal to "Present" THEN TLM shall display the Greeting Light menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "GreetingLights_Enable.Req" internal signals to "Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.GreetingLightsEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "True" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "GreetingLights_Enable.Req" internal signals as "Not_Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.GreetingLightsEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "False" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.GreetingLightsEnable" message THEN TLM updates the Greeting Lights information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal

IF "Half_Torque_Sensibility" PROXI parameter is equal to "Leve 3" THEN TLM shall display the " Lanse Sense Warning 1 " menu item and the user can perform setting with the following options: Early, Late
IF the user sets "LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Early" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Sensibility_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Early" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Late" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Sensibility_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Late" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Sensibility" message THEN TLM updates the LDW Sensibility information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal

IF "Half_Torque_Sensibility" PROXI parameter is equal to "Leve 2" THEN TLM shall display the " Lanse Sense Warning 2" menu item and the user can perform setting with the following options: Early, Med, Late
IF the user sets "LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Early" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Sensibility_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Early" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Med" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Sensibility_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Med" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Late" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Sensibility_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Late" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Sensibility" message THEN TLM updates the LDW Sensibility information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Half_HMI_Setting" PROXI parameter is equal to "Leve 3" THEN TLM shall display the " Lanse Sense Strenght 1 " menu item and the user can perform setting with the following options: Low, High
IF the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Low" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Low" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "High" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "High" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity" message THEN TLM updates the LDW Sensibility information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Half_HMI_Setting" PROXI parameter is equal to "Leve 2" THEN TLM shall display the " Lanse Sense Strenght 2" menu item and the user can perform setting with the following options: Low, Med, High
IF the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Low" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Low" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Med" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Med" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "High" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "High" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity" message THEN TLM updates the LDW Sensibility information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Side_Distance_Warning" PROXI parameters is equal to "Absent" THEN TLM shall not display the Side Distance Warning menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "Side_Distance_Warning" PROXI parameter is equal to "Present" THEN TLM shall display the Side Distance Warning "Setting" and "Chime Volume" menu items and the user can perform setting.
IF the user sets "Sdw_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Off" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Sdw_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Off" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "Sdw_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Sound" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Sdw_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Sound" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "Sdw_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Sound+Display" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Sdw_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Sound+Display" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Sdw" message THEN TLM updates the Side Distance Warning information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Sdw_Chime_Volume_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Low" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.SdwChimeVolume_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Low" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "Sdw_Chime_Volume_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Medium" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.SdwChimeVolume_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Medium" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "Sdw_Chime_Volume_Setting.Req" internal signals to "High" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.SdwChimeVolume_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "High" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.SdwChimeVolume" message THEN TLM updates the Side Distance Warning information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal

IF "Forward_Collision_Mitigation" PROXI parameter is equal to "Full Speed Forward Collision Warning with Mitigation" THEN TLM shall display the "Forward Collision Warinig Setting" and "Forward Collision Warning Sensitivity" menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF "Country_Code" PROXI parameter is equal to a country of NAFTA or LATAM market (according to Market Configuration Table) THEN TLM shall display the " Forward Collision Warning Setting1" menu item and the user can perform setting with the following options: Off, Audio, Audio_Brake
IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Off " THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusSetting_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Off " and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Audio" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusSetting_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Audio" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Audio_Brake" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusSetting_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Audio_Brake" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusSetting " message THEN TLM updates the Forward Collision Warning information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal

IF "Country_Code"PROXI parameter is not equal to a country of NAFTA/LATAM market (according to Market Configuration Table) THEN TLM shall display the " Forward Collision Warning Setting2" menu item and the user can perform setting with the following options: Off, Brake, Audio_Brake
IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Off " THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusSetting_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Off " and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Brake " THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusSetting_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Brake " and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Audio_Brake " THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusSetting_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Audio_Brake " and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusSetting " message THEN TLM updates the Forward Collision Warning information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal

IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Activation_Mode_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Near" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusActivationMode_Req " B-CAN signal equal to "Near" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Activation_Mode_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Med" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusActivationMode_Req " B-CAN signal equal to "Med" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "FSCWPlus_Activation_Mode_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Far" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusActivationMode_Req " B-CAN signal equal to "Far" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.FSFCWPlusActivationMode " message THEN TLM updates the Forward Collision Warning information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Rain_Sensor" PROXI parameter is equal to "present" THEN TLM shall display the Rain Sensor menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "Rain_Sensor_Level_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.RainSensorLevel_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Enable" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "Rain_Sensor_Level_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Not_Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.RainSensorLevel_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Not_Enable" and sends this signal to IPC
IF "Rain_Sensor" PROXI parameter is equal to "absent" THEN TLM shall not display the Rain Sensor menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.RainSensorLevel" message THEN TLM updates the Rain Sensor information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
TLM shall display the Clock Setting menu item and the user can perform setting.
IF the user sets "Hour1_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Hour information to VF456 through "Hour1_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Hour2_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Hour information to VF456 through "Hour2_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Minute1_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Minute information to VF456 through "Minute1_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Minute2_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Minute information to VF456 through "Minute1_Setting.Info" internal signal
TLM shall display the Hour Mode menu item and the user can perform setting.
IF the user sets "Hour_Mode_Setting.Req" internal signals to "0_24_h" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.HourMode_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "0_24_h" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "Hour_Mode_Setting.Req" internal signals to "0_12_h" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.HourMode_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "0_12_h" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.HourMode" message THEN TLM updates the Hour Mode information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Cluster_Display_Type" proxi parameter is equal to "Base Display" THEN TLM shall not display the Set Data menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
ELSE THEN TLM shall display the Set Data menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF the user sets "Day1_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Day information to VF456 through "Day1_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Day2_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Day information to VF456 through "Day2_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Month1_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Month information to VF456 through "Month1_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Month2_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Month information to VF456 through "Month2_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Year1_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Year information to VF456 through "Year1_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Year2_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Year information to VF456 through "Year2_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Year3_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Year information to VF456 through "Year3_Setting.Info" internal signal
IF the user sets "Year4_Setting.Req" internal signals THEN TLM updates and sends the Year information to VF456 through "Year4_Setting.Info" internal signal
TLM receives "Time_Date_Setting_Feedback.Info" from VF456 to update time and date information in the setup menu.
IF "Auto_Close_Menu" PROXI parameter is equal to "Disabled" THEN TLM shall not display the Speed Lock Door menu item and the user can not perform any settin
IF "Auto_Close_Menu" PROXI parameter is equal to "Enabled" THEN TLM shall display the Speed Lock Door menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "Speed_Lock_Door_Enable.Req" internal signals to "Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.SpeedLockDoorEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Enable" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "Speed_Lock_Door_Enable.Req" internal signals to "Not_Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.SpeedLockDoorEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Not_Enable" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.SpeedLockDoorEnable" message THEN TLM updates the Speed Lock Door information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
The LTM/ETM shall display the Unit Custom setting to allow the customer the ability to modify the measurement units setting.
IF "Odo_Units Change" PROXI parameter is equal to "absent" THEN TLM shall not display the Distance Measurement Unit menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "Odo_Units Change" PROXI parameter is equal to "present" THEN TLM shall display the Distance Measurement Unit menu item and the user can perform setting.
IF the user sets "Distance_Unit_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Km" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DistanceUnit_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Km" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "Distance_Unit_Setting.Req" internal signals as "Miles" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DistanceUnit_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Miles" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DistanceUnit" message THEN TLM updates the Distance Measurement Unit information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Fuel_Type" PROXI parameter is different to "CNG" or "GPL" THEN TLM shall display the Consumption Measurement Unit menu item and the user can perform setting.
IF "Odo_Units_Change" PROXI parameter is equal to "present" AND "Distance_Unit_Setting.Req" is equal to "km" THEN TLM shall display only the menu items "Km_Per_Litre" and "Litres_Per_100Km"
IF "Consumption_Unit_Setting.Req" is equal to "Km_Per_Litre" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ConsumptionUnit_Req" to "Km_Per_Litre" value.
IF "Consumption_Unit_Setting.Req" is equal to "Litres_Per_100Km" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ConsumptionUnit_Req" to "Litres_Per_100Km" value.
IF "Odo_Units_Change" PROXI parameter is equal to "present" AND "Distance_Unit_Setting.Req" is equal to "miles" THEN TLM shall display only the Consumption Unit menu item related to "mpg"

IF "Country_Code" PROXI parameter is equal to "United States of America" OR "GRENADA" OR "BURMA" OR "MEXICO" OR "CANADA" OR "PUERTO RICO" OR "LIBERIA" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ConsumptionUnit_Req" to "Miles_Per_Gallon_US" value.
ELSE THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ConsumptionUnit_Req" to "Miles_Per_Gallon_UK" value.
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ConsumptionUnit" message THEN TLM updates the Consumption Measurement Unit information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
ELSE THEN TLM shall not display the Consumption Measurement Unit menu item and the user can not perform setting.
IF "External_Temperature_Sensor" PROXI parameter is equal to "absent" THEN TLM shall not display the External Temperature Measurement Unit menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "External_Temperature_Sensor" PROXI parameter is equal to "present" THEN TLM shall display the External Temperature Measurement Unit menu item and the user can perform setting.
IF the user sets "Temperature_Unit_Setting.Req" internal signals to "°C" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.TemperatureUnit_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "°C" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "Temperature_Unit_Setting.Req" internal signals to "°F" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.TemperatureUnit_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "°F" and sends this signal to IPC

WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.TemperatureUnit" message THEN TLM updates the External TemperatureMeasurement Unit information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Tyre_Pressure_Unit_Menu" PROXI parameter is equal to "Absent" THEN TLM shall not display the Tyre Pressure Unit menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "Tyre_Pressure_Unit_Menu" PROXI parameter is equal to "Present" THEN TLM shall display the Tyre Pressure Unit menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "Tyre_Pressure_Unit_Setting.Req" internal signals to " kPa" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.TyrePressureUnit_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "kPa" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "Tyre_Pressure_Unit_Setting.Req" internal signals to " psi" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.TyrePressureUnit_Req" B-CAN signal equal to " psi" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "TyrePressureUnit_Req" internal signals to " bar" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.TyrePressureUnit_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "bar" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.TyrePressureUnit" message THEN TLM updates the Tyre Pressure Unit information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
display the "Language" menu item. display the language SETS described in "Market Configuration Table" document according to "Country_Code" PROXI parameter
IF the user sets a language througt "Language_Setting.Req" internal signal THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.LanguageSelection_Req" to the corresponding selected value.
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.LanguageSelection" message THEN TLM updates the Language information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF TLM receives a negative Ack from IPC THEN the TLM has to maintain the language previously selected.
IF "DRL_Menù_Enable" PROXI parameter is equal to "Disabled" THEN TLM shall not display the DRL menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "DRL_Menù_Enable" PROXI parameter is equal to "Enabled" THEN TLM shall display the DRL menu item and the user can perform setting.
IF the user sets "DRL_Enable.Req" internal signals to "Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DRLEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "True" and sends this signal to IPC
IF the user sets "DRL_Enable.Req" internal signals to "Disable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DRLEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "False" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DRLEnable" message THEN TLM updates the DRL information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Twilight_Sensor" PROXI parameter is equal to "absent" THEN TLM shall not display the External Light Sensor menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "Twilight_Sensor" PROXI parameter is equal to "present" THEN TLM shall display the External Light Sensor menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "External_Light_Sensor_Level.Req" internal signal to "Level_1" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ExternalLightSensorLevel_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Level_1" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "External_Light_Sensor_Level_Setting.Req" internal signal to "Level_2" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ExternalLightSensorLevel_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Level_2" and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "External_Light_Sensor_Level_Setting.Req" internal signal to "Level_3" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ExternalLightSensorLevel_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Level_3" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.ExternalLightSensorLevel" message THEN TLM updates the External light Sensor information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
TLM shall display the Headlights Off Delay menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "Headlights_Off_Delay_Setting.Req" internal signal to " 0 " THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.HeadlightsOffDelay_Req " B-CAN signal equal to " 0 " and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "Headlights_Off_Delay_Setting.Req " internal signal to " 30 " THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.HeadlightsOffDelay_Req " B-CAN signal equal to " 30 " and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "Headlights_Off_Delay_Setting.Req " internal signal to " 60 " THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.HeadlightsOffDelay_Req " B-CAN signal equal to " 60 " and sends this signal to IPC

IF the user sets "Headlights_Off_Delay_Setting.Req " internal signal to " 90 " THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.HeadlightsOffDelay_Req " B-CAN signal equal to " 90 " and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.HeadlightsOffDelay" message THEN TLM updates the Headlights Off Delay information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal

IF "CAN node 51 (LBSS)" == "Present" AND "CAN node 52 (RBSS)" == "Present" THEN TLM shall display the Blind Spot Detection menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "Blind_Spot_Detection_Setting.Req" internal signal to "Not_Enable" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.BSDEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Not_Enable" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.BSDEnable" message THEN TLM updates the Blind Spot information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Passive_Entry_Menu" PROXI parameter is equal to "Absent" THEN TLM shall not display the Passive Entry menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "Passive_Entry_Menu" PROXI parameter is equal to "Present" THEN TLM shall display the Passive Entry menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "Passive_Entry_Enable.Req" internal signals to "Off" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.PassiveEntry_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Off" and sends this signal to IPC
WHEN TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.PassiveEntry" message THEN TLM updates the Passive Entry information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF "Remote_Door_Unlock_Menu" PROXI parameter is equal to "Absent" THEN TLM shall not display the Remote Door Unlock menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF "Remote_Door_Unlock_Menu" PROXI parameter is equal to "Present" THEN TLM shall display the Remote Door Unlock menu item and the user can perform setting.

IF the user sets "Remote_Door_Unlock_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Driver" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.RemoteDoorUnlock._Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Driver" and sends this signal to IPC

IF TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.TelematicSetupACK"equal to "No_ACK_Required" value. THEN TLM has to ignore this signal
IF TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.TelematicSetupACK"equal to "ACK_KO" value. THEN TLM has to visualize a message related to the failure (see HMI document).
IF TLM receives "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.TelematicSetupACK"equal to "ACK_OK" value. THEN TLM has to visualize the new parameters transmitted by IPC ("IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP" message).

IF TLM sends a request of vehicle setup to TBM through "TELEMATIC_SERVICE_SETUP" message THEN TLM has to wait for the "Acnowledge" through "SERVICE_SETUP.TelematicSetupACK" from TBM to confirm the corrected reception and storage of the settings requested
IF TLM receives "SERVICE_SETUP.TelematicSetupACK"equal to "No_ACK_Required" value. THEN TLM has to ignore this signal
IF TLM receives "SERVICE_SETUP.TelematicSetupACK"equal to "ACK_KO" value. THEN TLM has to visualize a message related to the failure (see HMI document).
IF TLM receives "SERVICE_SETUP.TelematicSetupACK"equal to "ACK_OK" value. THEN TLM has to visualize the new parameters transmitted by TBM ("SERVICE_SETUP" message).

In case absence of IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP or IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2 B-CAN message in Key On, TLM has to store an appropriate DTC in according to validation requirements defined in the CDD document. IF TLM doesn't receive these messages within "TimeOut1" THEN TLM has to resend the new vehicle setup request (This logic must be implemented for a max of three times after TLM has to visualize a message to the user about the failure of request )
WHEN "LTM_OperationalModeSts.Info" == "SNA" THEN LTM shall: keep the last valid value that has been recognized.

In the following Ignition Working Condition: "Ignition Off" "Ignition On" "Ignition On Engine On" IF TLM does not receive the SERVICE_SETUP message for a time equal to T_REC_TBM AND IF CAN Node 35 (TBM) PROXI Parameter is equals to "Present" AND FOTA_State.Info internal signal is equal to "NO_FOTA_State" THEN TLM shall set the DTC, according to "TLM Diagnostic Requirement" document.

IF TLM doesn't receive "SERVICE_SETUP.TelematicSetupACK" within "TimeOut1" THEN TLM has to resend the new vehicle setup request (This logic must be implemented for a max of three times after TLM has to visualize a message to the user about the failure of request )
As soon as TLM receives again SERVICE_SETUP message, TLM shall: heal the DTC, according to the requirements specified in the "TLM Diagnostic Requirement" document.
